items.exampleEn: The grouping of students changes every term.
items.exampleZh: 學生的分組每學期都會改變。

items.exampleEn: Animals can be categorized into different groups.
items.exampleZh: 動物可以被分類成不同的群體。

items.exampleEn: The school's motto is written above the main door.
items.exampleZh: 學校的校訓寫在大門上方。

items.exampleEn: Some chemists work for food companies.
items.exampleZh: 有些化學家在食品公司工作。

items.exampleEn: There are twenty-six letters in the English alphabet.
items.exampleZh: 英文字母表共有二十六個字母。
這套百科全書共有二十冊。

items.exampleEn: The famous mathematician solved the problem in one night.
items.exampleZh: 那位知名的數學家一個晚上就解出了這道題。

items.sentenceEn: My little sister is learning the alphabet.

items.audioEn: Please write your name on the form in clear handwriting.
items.audioZh: 請用清楚的字跡在表格上寫下你的名字。
items.questionZh: 說話者要大家怎麼寫名字？
options: In red ink, at the top.
On the back of the form.
Clearly, so it's easy to read.

items.sentenceEn: My dream is to become a mathematician.
items.sentenceZh: 我的夢想是成為數學家。

items.sentenceEn: Let's categorize these photos by year.
items.sentenceZh: 我們把這些照片按年份分類吧。

items.stemEn: My grandfather gave me an old ____ with beautiful pictures of animals.
items.stemZh: 爺爺送我一套有漂亮動物圖片的舊百科全書。

items.stemEn: The ____ spent years testing new kinds of medicine.
items.stemZh: 那位化學家花了好幾年測試新的藥物。

items.passageEn: This term, our class wrote a report on famous scientists. First, our teacher changed the grouping, so I worked with three new classmates. We used an old encyclopedia and the internet to find information. We chose a chemist and a mathematician. Then we had to categorize our facts into three parts: early life, work, and later life. One member wrote the notes by hand, but her handwriting was hard to read, so we typed them. The mathematician's motto was "Ask why." We liked it so much that we made it our group's motto, too. The report was challenging but fun.
items.passageZh: 這學期，我們班寫了一份關於知名科學家的報告。首先，老師改變了分組，所以我和三位新同學一組。我們用一本舊的百科全書和網路找資料。我們選了一位化學家和一位數學家。接著，我們必須把資料分成三類：早年生活、工作和晚年生活。有一位組員用手寫筆記，但她的字跡很難看懂，所以我們把筆記打成電子檔。那位數學家的座右銘是「問為什麼」。我們很喜歡，所以也把它當成我們小組的座右銘。這份報告很有挑戰性，但很好玩。

questions.questionZh: 他們怎麼分類找到的資料？
options: 按照科學家出生的年份和國家來排列
分成早年、工作和晚年三部分

questions.questionZh: 為什麼他們把筆記打成電子檔？
options: 因為老師規定要交電子檔
因為那位組員的手寫字跡很難看懂

referenceEn: His handwriting is better than mine.
His handwriting looks better than mine.
rubricZh: handwriting 表示「字跡」，例如 good handwriting 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 motto 造一個句子，說說你的座右銘。
referenceEn: My motto is "Try your best every day."
I live by the motto "Be kind to everyone."
rubricZh: motto 表示「座右銘」，例如 My motto is… 等說法
說的是自己的想法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式；說過去的事用過去式等）
